Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam

Coinbase said its AI scam-prevention agent stopped about $4.7 million, roughly 91% of what customers tried to send, from reaching scammers running a deepfake Elon Musk crypto giveaway.

German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin

A Leipzig judge has offered to dismiss the Movie2k criminal case if the defendant hands over 40,000 bitcoin, which would leave him about 16,000 coins worth roughly $1.02 billion.
